GIMP does not support native CMYK color mode conversion. GIMP is fundamentally an RGB-based image editor and does not have built-in CMYK color mode support. When attempting to convert the image to a CMYK profile through Image > Color Management > Convert to Color Profile, GIMP displayed an error: 'ICC profile validation failed: Color profile is not For RGB color space.' This confirms that GIMP cannot convert images to CMYK mode.

For CMYK conversion, you would need to use:
1. Adobe Photoshop (which has native CMYK support)
2. An online CMYK converter tool
3. Other professional graphic design software with CMYK support (like Affinity Photo, Scribus with proper plugins, etc.)

The image 'gate.jpeg' remains in RGB color mode (RGB color 8-bit gamma integer, GIMP built-in sRGB) in GIMP.
